name: person-brief
description: Pre-meeting and pre-call intelligence for busy professionals. Synthesizes the last 30 days of activity on a person across Reddit, X, Hacker News, YouTube, GitHub, and the open web — then merges that signal with your Cloud Brain history of the relationship to produce a one-page brief before every important conversation. Designed to run as a calendar-triggered prep agent so you walk into every meeting already informed.
